- Core milestones (POC, integration, security review, pilot validation, go-live)
- Suggested owners (Redwood owner + Helix counterpart)
- Dependencies we flagged (SOC2 evidence, network peering window, data-retention policy sign-off)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Ben — quick internal note after reviewing the MAP draft. I dropped a few inline suggestions in the PDF but pulled the highlights here so we stay aligned before Ben sends the next update to Helix: 

- Milestone: move "pilot validation" earlier as a success gate (week 4 for aggressive path) and call out the acceptance criteria (latency < 250ms p95, 99% request success).
- Owners: recommend listing both the Redwood engineering owner and a Helix integration lead for each milestone to avoid ambiguity.
- Dependencies: add "legal playbook sign-off" as a pre-go-live dependency (legal needs 2 weeks).
- Risk: flag the SOC2 evidence lag as high; suggest asking for the SOC2 mapping now so our security team can pre-scan.

I also recommend offering a short "kickoff checklist" for the first 72 hours after the MAP is accepted (share service account, provide sample data, set up test workspace).

If you want, I can hop on the sync to review the security asks.
